sourceName: Abel & Cohen bilateral international migration flow estimates (updated with UN DESA IMS 2024 / WPP 2024 inputs)
methodNote: Demographic accounting, pseudo-Bayesian average of migrant transitions and stayers — closed system. Abel & Cohen (2019) find closed demographic-accounting methods correlate best with reported flow data.
notes: Estimated five-year migration FLOWS (people who moved origin→destination during 2015–2020), not stocks and not ethnic/ancestry diasporas. Rounded da_pb_closed to integers; zeros omitted. UN-195 only.
